caption: The drawing features two main objects. At the top, there is an oval-shaped illustration bordered by a decorative, swirling pattern in grayish-white. Inside the oval are two figures: the figure on the left has dark hair and is wearing an orange-yellow dress with a fitted bodice and a wide skirt, while the figure on the right has light hair and is dressed in a green coat with white cuffs and a white necktie or cravat. The background of the oval appears to be brownish with some suggestions of drapery or a setting behind the figures. Below the oval is an elongated cylindrical box with a flat top, depicted in perspective to show its three-dimensional shape. The box’s top is a wood-like light brown color. Around the side of the box is a wide, colorful band featuring a floral and leafy design with prominent hues of red, pink, orange, yellow, light green, and dark green, interspersed with black swirling accents. The band is bounded by borders of white spiral or scroll shapes at the top and bottom. The drawing is signed “Jessica Price” in the bottom left of the image, and additional markings are present in the bottom right corner. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige tone.
title: Pa. German Bride's Box
